description: This file defines the EncounterService interface in the OpenMRS API, outlining methods for managing encounters, encounter types, roles, and related operations within the system.

classes.name: EncounterService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for managing encounters, encounter types, roles, and related operations in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: setEncounterDAO
methods.description: Sets the data access object for encounter persistence.

methods.name: saveEncounter
methods.description: Saves or updates an encounter, with cascading behavior for related entities and applying business rules.

methods.name: getEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves an encounter by its internal identifier.

methods.name: getEncounterByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an encounter by its UUID.

methods.name: getEncountersByPatient
methods.description: Retrieves all non-voided encounters for a given patient.

methods.name: getEncountersByPatientId
methods.description: Retrieves all non-voided encounters for a patient identified by ID.

methods.name: getEncountersByPatientIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves all encounters for a patient identified by an external identifier.

methods.name: getEncounters
methods.description: Retrieves encounters based on search criteria such as location, date range, encounter type, provider, etc.

methods.name: voidEncounter
methods.description: Voids an encounter with a reason, cascading to related observations and orders.

methods.name: unvoidEncounter
methods.description: Unvoids an encounter, restoring it to active status.

methods.name: purgeEncounter
methods.description: Permanently deletes an encounter from the database, for super users.

methods.name: saveEncounterType
methods.description: Creates or updates an encounter type.

methods.name: getEncounterType
methods.description: Retrieves an encounter type by internal ID.

methods.name: getEncounterTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an encounter type by UUID.

methods.name: getEncounterType
methods.description: Retrieves an encounter type by its exact name.

methods.name: getAllEncounterTypes
methods.description: Returns all encounter types, including retired ones.

methods.name: getAllEncounterTypes
methods.description: Returns all encounter types with option to include retired types.

methods.name: findEncounterTypes
methods.description: Finds encounter types whose names start with the given string, case-insensitive.

methods.name: retireEncounterType
methods.description: Marks an encounter type as retired with a reason.

methods.name: unretireEncounterType
methods.description: Unretires an encounter type, making it usable again.

methods.name: purgeEncounterType
methods.description: Permanently deletes an encounter type from the database.

methods.name: getEncountersByPatient
methods.description: Search encounters by patient name or identifier.

methods.name: getEncounters
methods.description: Advanced search for encounters by various criteria with support for pagination.

methods.name: getEncountersByVisit
methods.description: Retrieve encounters associated with a specific visit, optionally including voided ones.

methods.name: getEncountersByVisit
methods.description: Retrieve encounters in a visit with voided inclusion option.

methods.name: getCountOfEncounters
methods.description: Counts encounters matching a search phrase, optionally including voided.

methods.name: getAllEncounters
methods.description: Retrieves all encounters for a cohort of patients.

methods.name: getEncountersNotAssignedToAnyVisit
methods.description: Fetches unvoided encounters for a patient not linked to any visit.

methods.name: getEncountersByVisitsAndPatient
methods.description: Fetch encounters for a patient including visits; supports filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getEncountersByVisitsAndPatientCount
methods.description: Counts encounters for patient and visit criteria.

methods.name: filterEncountersByViewPermissions
methods.description: Filters encounters based on user permissions.

methods.name: canViewAllEncounterTypes
methods.description: Checks if a user can view all encounter types.

methods.name: canEditAllEncounterTypes
methods.description: Checks if a user can edit all encounter types.

methods.name: canEditEncounter
methods.description: Checks if user can edit a specific encounter.

methods.name: canViewEncounter
methods.description: Checks if user can view a specific encounter.

methods.name: checkIfEncounterTypesAreLocked
methods.description: Verifies whether encounter types are locked to prevent modifications.

methods.name: getEncounterRolesByName
methods.description: Finds encounter roles matching a name.

methods.name: saveEncounterRole
methods.description: Creates or updates an encounter role.

methods.name: getEncounterRole
methods.description: Retrieves an encounter role by internal ID.

methods.name: getEncounterRoleByUuid
methods.description: Finds an encounter role via UUID.

methods.name: getEncounterRoleByName
methods.description: Finds an encounter role by name.

methods.name: retireEncounterRole
methods.description: Retires an encounter role with a reason.

methods.name: unretireEncounterRole
methods.description: Reverses retirement of an encounter role.

methods.name: purgeEncounterRole
methods.description: Permanently deletes an encounter role.

methods.name: getAllEncounterRoles
methods.description: Retrieves all encounter roles with optional inclusion of retired ones.

methods.name: getEncounterVisitHandlers
methods.description: Returns list of visit assignment handlers.

methods.name: getActiveEncounterVisitHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the current active visit assignment handler.

methods.name: getEncounterRoles
methods.description: Retrieves encounter roles by name.

methods.name: transferEncounter
methods.description: Transfers an encounter to another patient, voids original, and handles linked observations and visits.
